description: The line plot illustrates the Macro-F1 Score (%) as a function of the Number of tokens, comparing two models: “MATTER (ours)” and “w/o material information,” across a range of token counts from approximately 0.6 to 1.5. The x-axis, labeled “Number of tokens,” spans from 0.6 to 1.5 with major tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis, labeled “Macro-F1 Score (%)”, ranges from 48 to 58 with tick marks at intervals of 2. The “MATTER (ours)” model is represented by a pink line with circular markers and a corresponding light pink shaded region indicating variance or confidence interval; this line starts at approximately 55.0% at 0.6 tokens, dips slightly to ~54.3% at 0.7, rises to a peak of ~58.0% at 1.0 tokens, then declines to ~51.0% at 1.5 tokens. The “w/o material information” model is shown as a purple line with circular markers and a light purple shaded region; it begins at ~52.5% at 0.6 tokens, peaks at ~54.2% at 0.7 tokens, then gradually declines to ~51.8% at 1.3 tokens before dropping sharply to ~47.5% at 1.5 tokens. Both lines exhibit fluctuations, with the “MATTER (ours)” model consistently outperforming the ablated version across most token counts, particularly around 1.0 tokens where the performance gap is largest.
